Name: Merodach-baladan
Summary: Merodach-baladan, son of Baladan, was king of Babylon who sent letters and a present to Hezekiah after hearing of his sickness and recovery; Hezekiah showed the envoys all his treasures, and Isaiah foretold that Babylon would one day carry them away.
KeyStory: Babylon's envoys came to Hezekiah, who showed them his silver, gold, spices, and armoury — and Isaiah announced that everything in the palace would be carried to Babylon.
LifeLesson: Showing off what God gave you to impress a foreign power invites the very loss you boast about.
